Wikipedia leaves the snippet to search.

HSTS is preloaded, security.txt is published, and articles read without JavaScript. But the Main Page and the other 18 pages read have no meta description, so search engines pick the snippet.

Lesson: Write a description of about 150 characters for each key page, so you choose the pitch, not the crawler.

One automated read of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.

Mozilla: 85 languages, no sitemap.

The home page lists 85 hreflang alternates, HSTS is on, and framing is denied. But robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml answers 404, so crawlers find pages only by following links.

Lesson: Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.
